answer: Proof-of-stake functions as a reliable beacon for identity validation by requiring agents to lock collateral as a wharf for capital. An attacker attempting a Sybil strike must acquire significant tokens to influence the network, a feat analogous to shifting a massive ferrous mass against a powerful magnetic gradient. This high barrier to entry ensures that generating duplicate pseudonymous nodes becomes prohibitively expensive, as the marginal cost of attack scales linearly with the total supply.
